verses.text: “Don’t let your hearts be troubled. Believe in God, and believe in me too.
There are many rooms in my Father’s house. If that weren’t true, I would’ve told you. I’m going there to prepare a place for you.
And if I go and prepare a place for you, I’ll come back and bring you to be with me, so you can be where I am.
You know where I’m going, and you know the way there.”
Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you’re going. How can we know the way?”
Jesus said, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
If you really knew me, you’d know my Father too. From now on, you do know him and have seen him.”
Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That’s all we need.”
Jesus said to him, “Philip, have I been with you all this time and you still don’t know me? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father. So why ask, ‘Show us the Father’?
Don’t you believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words I tell you aren’t from me. The Father living in me is doing his work.
Believe me when I say I am in the Father and the Father is in me. Or at least believe because of the works themselves.
I’m telling you the truth: Whoever believes in me will do the works I’ve been doing. They’ll do even greater works, because I’m going to the Father.
Whatever you ask in my name, I’ll do it, so the Father may be glorified through the Son.
If you ask me for anything in my name, I’ll do it.
“If you love me, keep my commands.
I’ll ask the Father, and he’ll give you another Helper to be with you forever:
the Spirit of truth. The world can’t receive him because it doesn’t see or know him. You know him, because he stays with you and will be in you.
I won’t leave you like orphans. I’ll come to you.
In just a little while, the world won’t see me anymore, but you will see me. Because I live, you will live too.
When that day comes, you’ll know I am in my Father, you are in me, and I am in you.
Whoever has my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me. Whoever loves me will be loved by my Father. I’ll love them too and show myself to them.”
Judas—not Judas Iscariot—said to him, “Lord, why are you going to show yourself to us and not to the world?”
Jesus answered, “Anyone who loves me will keep my word. My Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.
Anyone who doesn’t love me won’t keep my words. The word you hear isn’t mine; it comes from the Father who sent me.
“I’ve told you these things while I’m still with you.
But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you everything and remind you of all I’ve told you.
I leave you peace. I give you my peace, not the way the world gives it. Don’t let your hearts be troubled or afraid.
You heard me say, ‘I’m going away, and I’ll come back to you.’ If you loved me, you’d be glad I’m going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I am.
I’ve told you this before it happens, so that when it does happen, you’ll believe.
I won’t talk with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. He has no hold over me.
But the world must know that I love the Father and do exactly what the Father commanded me. Get up; let’s leave this place.
